svg.title: Glasses, three-quarter view facing right: the far lens is foreshortened to about two thirds of the near one and the temple arm runs back across the cheek to the ear, which is a cue for the turn as much as it is a pair of glasses. The lens glint is white and sits clear of the pupil, so it reads on all six skin ramps. A cosmetic feature that works in every locomotion mode the game has.
